name: NVIDIA VSS Video Summarization Workflow
short_description: Long-video summarization and event extraction pipeline with VIOS, VLM and LLM orchestration.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: 8x PCIe GPUs; example split 4x LLM + 4x shared VLM/embedding/reranker from older VSS performance docs
reference_deployments.notes: Numbers are from VSS health-eval example metrics and should be treated as a calibration baseline, not a universal promise.

pipeline_roles.notes: Video ingestion and storage layer.
Can be replaced if the substitute supports chunked long-video interpretation.
Primary reasoning and summary generation role; Hungarian-friendly models should be allowed here.
May be disabled or swapped depending on workflow.

risk_notes: Changing VLM can shift token volume and chunk latency significantly.
Changing LLM affects summary quality, latency and language coverage.
For Hungarian output, replace the default LLM with a Hungarian-capable model or an LLM known to handle Hungarian well.

known_limitations: Shared GPU mode validation is limited on some GPUs and model combinations.
Chunk size and video duration heavily affect latency and token usage.

name: NVIDIA VSS Warehouse 2D Vision AI Profile
short_description: Single-camera warehouse analytics pipeline with RT-DETR, tracking and behavior analytics.

pipeline_roles.notes: Primary object detection stage.
Tracking and rule-based analytics microservices.
Optional narrative/event explanation layer for localized outputs.

risk_notes: Detector swaps change stream capacity directly.
Hungarian requirements typically matter only for optional alert text or explanation stages, not the detector.

known_limitations: Latency varies with object count, ROIs, tripwires and machine load.
Changing hardware or stream count requires coordinated config tuning.

name: NVIDIA VSS Warehouse 2D Vision AI with Agents Profile
short_description: Warehouse 2D profile with RT-DETR plus agentic UI, chat and optional LLM/VLM layers.

pipeline_roles.notes: Real-time detector.
Used for richer incident understanding and multimodal incident analysis.
Chat, alert summarization and operator-facing explanations.

risk_notes: Shared-GPU validation is limited for non-default LLM/VLM combinations on some GPUs.
For Hungarian operator UIs, the llm_role should be replaced explicitly.

known_limitations: On H100 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, only default NIMs were tested in shared GPU mode.
On some platforms local NIMs are not supported and remote NIMs are required.

name: NVIDIA VSS Warehouse 3D Vision AI Profile
short_description: Multi-camera 3D warehouse analytics with Sparse4D and behavior analytics.

pipeline_roles.notes: Primary 3D perception model.
Analytics over tracks and events.
Optional incident reporting or Hungarian-language summary stage.

risk_notes: 3D perception substitutions can alter camera-count scaling and calibration assumptions.
This blueprint is more sensitive to scene geometry and calibration quality than 2D.

known_limitations: Latency varies with object count, ROIs, tripwires and machine load.
Calibration and synchronization are operational constraints.

name: NVIDIA RAG Blueprint
short_description: Modular self-hosted enterprise RAG pipeline with swappable LLM, embedding, ranking, VLM and parsing services.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: Default docs GPU mapping: GPU0 shared by embedding/ranking/ocr/vectorstore; GPU1 LLM; GPU5 optional VLM
reference_deployments.notes: These are deployment characteristics rather than p50 latency benchmarks.

pipeline_roles.notes: Main answer-generation model.
Swap for multilingual/Hungarian-friendly retrieval as needed.
Strongly impacts retrieval quality in Hungarian.
Optional multimodal query role.
Document ingestion stack can be customized for PDFs and images.

risk_notes: Retrieval quality can drop sharply if embedding and reranker are not strong on Hungarian.
Component placement and shared-GPU defaults affect capacity; a substitute model may require a different GPU map.

known_limitations: Self-hosted deployments require significant disk for model downloads and cache.
Multiple services share a GPU by default, so substitutions can force a remap.

name: NVIDIA AI-Q Research Agent Blueprint
short_description: Long-running, graph-based research agent blueprint with optional RAG subsystem and cluster sizing guidance.

reference_deployments.hardware_label: Enterprise RA 2-8-5-200 on RTX PRO 6000 BSE
reference_deployments.notes: Reference architecture provides sizing and scaling guidance; workload-level throughput must still be calibrated.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: Meta Llama 70B NIM or other configured agent LLM
pipeline_roles.notes: Intent routing, orchestration and answer generation.
Fast bounded research path.
Multi-step iterative research path.
Optional retrieval subsystem.

risk_notes: Replacing agent LLMs changes token economics, concurrency and research depth behavior.
If Hungarian is a requirement, both the agent LLM and any attached RAG components should be swapped deliberately.

known_limitations: Published tests in the reference architecture excluded human-in-the-loop.
Sizing guidance is cluster-oriented and should be translated to node-level simulations carefully.

name: NVIDIA PDF to Podcast Blueprint
short_description: Multistage PDF-to-markdown, script-generation and text-to-speech pipeline for turning documents into spoken audio content.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: LLM + parsing + optional speech/TTS services on shared or split GPUs depending on runtime profile
reference_deployments.notes: Throughput depends strongly on document length, parser choice, TTS voice quality, and whether stages are serialized or pipelined.

pipeline_roles.notes: Extracts structured document content from PDF before generation.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: Llama-family instruction LLM via NIM or HF
pipeline_roles.notes: Converts extracted content into monologue/dialogue style audio script.
Synthesizes final audio waveform from generated script.

risk_notes: TTS quality and latency vary significantly by voice model and language.
Long PDFs can shift the bottleneck from LLM decode to document parsing or audio synthesis.

known_limitations: End-to-end time scales with PDF length and target audio duration.
Audio quality and cost vary significantly if external TTS is used.

name: NVIDIA Retail Shopping Assistant Blueprint
short_description: Retail-focused multimodal shopping assistant with retrieval, image-aware product grounding, and safety guardrails.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: 4x H100 class recommendation for LLM + embeddings + NVCLIP + vector DB acceleration
reference_deployments.notes: NVIDIA build page recommends a 4 H100 class self-hosted profile for the default stack.

pipeline_roles.notes: Generates grounded shopping responses and recommendations.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: NVIDIA Retrieval QA E5 Embedding v5
pipeline_roles.notes: Primary text retrieval embedding role.
Product image grounding and multimodal retrieval.
Keeps answers safe and on-brand.

risk_notes: Replacing the guardrail stack can materially change production-readiness.
Multilingual retail catalogs may require stronger non-English embedding/reranking than the default English-centric stack.

known_limitations: Reference design is retail-specific and assumes a product catalog plus imagery.
Capacity estimates should separate retrieval, safety, and generation bottlenecks.

name: NVIDIA Biomedical AI-Q Research Agent Blueprint
short_description: Domain-specialized AI-Q research agent for biomedical discovery with multimodal retrieval, external tools, and report generation.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: Separate GPUs for multimodal ingestion, reasoning, and instruct/report generation models
reference_deployments.notes: Build page specifies heavy local requirements and multiple service classes.

pipeline_roles.notes: Primary deep reasoning and synthesis role.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: Instruction model for final report generation
pipeline_roles.notes: Generates structured final outputs for users.
Retrieval over scientific documents, tables, and graphics.
Coordinates access to biomedical tools and knowledge APIs.

risk_notes: This blueprint is substantially heavier than generic AI-Q and should be simulated as a multi-stage agent workload, not a simple QPS RAG app.
Tool latency and external API fan-out can dominate end-to-end response time.

known_limitations: Very infrastructure-heavy compared with standard enterprise RAG.
Quality depends on both retrieval stack and external scientific tool integration.

name: NVIDIA Real-Time Voice Call Processing
short_description: Real-time phone and voice-stream processing pipeline with streaming ASR, diarization, optional translation, and optional live agent assist.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: ASR and speech analytics can run on shared GPUs; agent-assist or TTS may be isolated on separate GPUs for tighter p95 latency.
reference_deployments.notes: Sizing is driven by concurrent calls, chunk size, diarization, translation, and whether live agent-assist generation is enabled.

pipeline_roles.notes: Converts live call audio into streaming text segments.
Separates speakers and improves call analytics fidelity.
Optional live translation for multilingual call handling.
Optional real-time assist for contact-center or operator workflows.
Optional synthesized response or voice bot output.

risk_notes: Real-time speech workloads are dominated by concurrency and per-chunk latency, not only by request QPS.
Translation and agent-assist materially increase p95 latency and GPU reservation needs.

known_limitations: Chunk size and concurrency strongly affect latency.
Agent-assist and TTS should be modeled as optional pipeline branches, not always-on costs.

name: NVIDIA Route Optimization with cuOpt
short_description: Dynamic route and dispatch optimization workload based on NVIDIA cuOpt for vehicle routing, replanning, and constraint-heavy optimization.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: Single or few-GPU solver nodes depending on optimization batch size and SLA targets.
reference_deployments.notes: Sizing is driven by stops, vehicles, constraints, and replanning frequency rather than token throughput.

pipeline_roles.notes: Normalizes jobs, vehicles, and constraints into a solver-ready form.
Core solver for VRP, dispatch, and dynamic replanning.
Publishes optimized routes to downstream systems.

risk_notes: Optimization workloads are dominated by constraint count, stop count, and solve SLA, not LLM token rates.
Dynamic replanning should be modeled as burst amplification on top of baseline solve arrivals.

known_limitations: External travel-time matrix or map-service latency can dominate end-to-end wall time.
Solver performance can shift sharply with constraint cardinality.

name: NVIDIA Predictive Maintenance & Forecasting (Reference Pattern)
short_description: Reference workload for sensor-driven predictive maintenance, short-horizon forecasting and anomaly alerting on industrial or infrastructure telemetry.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: One or few GPUs handle forecasting and anomaly scoring while CPU handles sensor ingest and alert fan-out.
reference_deployments.notes: Sizing is driven by monitored assets, telemetry density, inference refresh interval and anomaly branch enablement rather than token throughput.

pipeline_roles.notes: Builds normalized telemetry windows per asset or system component.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: Forecast model for load, failure or degradation trends
pipeline_roles.notes: Produces short-horizon forecasts or degradation predictions from sliding telemetry windows.
Optional anomaly branch for alert scoring and incident prioritization.
Publishes forecast breaches and anomaly alerts to downstream systems.

risk_notes: Prediction quality depends on telemetry quality and feature windows, not only on GPU size.
Alerting branches should be modeled as optional overhead rather than always-on inference cost.

known_limitations: Historical feature engineering quality is not inferred automatically from the selected runtime.
Per-asset signal seasonality and retraining cadence are outside the online inference sizing scope.

name: NVIDIA Recommendation & Ranking (Reference Pattern)
short_description: Low-latency retrieval, reranking and optional multimodal grounding pipeline for recommendations, search ranking and offer personalization.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: Embedding/ranking models can share GPUs, while optional multimodal grounding may be isolated on a separate GPU for tighter latency.
reference_deployments.notes: Sizing is driven by request rate, candidate pool size, reranking depth, personalization joins and optional image grounding.

pipeline_roles.notes: Builds the first-stage candidate set from query, user context and catalog metadata.
Optional ranking stage to improve final ordering quality over the initial candidate pool.
Optional multimodal grounding for image-aware or catalog-rich recommendation experiences.
Applies personalization, policy constraints and merchandising rules to final ranked results.

risk_notes: Request cost scales with candidate pool size and reranking depth faster than with raw QPS alone.
Multilingual catalogs may need stronger retrieval/ranking models than English-only defaults.

known_limitations: Offline relevance quality and click-through lift are outside the runtime sizing model.
Catalog cache hit rates and vector-store latency should still be validated separately in production design.

name: NVIDIA Financial Fraud Detection
short_description: Real-time transaction scoring pipeline with graph risk enrichment, fraud classification and downstream case publishing.

reference_deployments.gpu_topology: Graph scoring and classifier inference can share one or more GPUs depending on event rate and blocking SLA.
reference_deployments.notes: Sizing is driven by event throughput, entity graph fan-out, blocking SLA, explainability overhead and graph feature usage.

pipeline_roles.default_model_reference: Feature engineering and policy normalization service
pipeline_roles.notes: Builds normalized feature vectors and rule inputs from live transactions.
Optional entity-graph scoring branch for higher accuracy and lower false positives.
Primary fraud decisioning model for approve / review / block style outputs.
Produces analyst-facing reason codes or case context when enabled.
Publishes decisions or review cases to downstream systems.

risk_notes: Lower false-positive targets often increase per-event compute and explainability overhead.
Entity expansion and graph features can dominate latency more than raw transaction QPS.

known_limitations: Case-management throughput and analyst review queues are not modeled as full downstream systems.
Training-data drift and threshold retuning are outside the online inference simulation scope.
